commentary: While benchmark indices staged a sharp FII-driven expansion, the deterministic breadth score of 41 keeps the market gate at WEAK. William O'Neil and Stan Weinstein emphasized that headline index rallies masking sub-50 market breadth frequently represent narrow distribution rather than a broad Stage 2 market advance. In Jesse Livermore's discipline, the general market trend dictates 75% of stock performance. Consequently, Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rule applies: demand rigorous CANSLIM earnings confirmation, restrict risk strictly to tight base pivots, never chase breakouts extended from proper bases, and maintain defense until market breadth expands decisively.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Carving a wide double bottom base attempting to emerge over moving averages. While price reclaimed the 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA on 1.63x volume toward the 117.02 trigger, overhead base resistance remains heavy and relative strength lacks leadership traits.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Weak fundamental quality with 3-year average ROE languishing at 3.1%, ROCE at 5.6%, and thin net margins (~1.5%). Revenue growth of 5.3% falls far short of CANSLIM standards, reflecting absent institutional sponsorship.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails on a breakdown below the 106.41 base low; cut losses quickly to preserve capital.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Forming an orderly double bottom consolidation above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Long lower wicks show steady accumulation near support. RSI at 62 displays constructive momentum heading toward the 528.03 trigger.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Operations experienced a decisive inflection in Q2 FY27, with net profit surging 83.2% and revenue up 26.6%. EBITDA margins reached a multi-year high of 16.6% via backward integration at Sayakha, while debt-to-equity remains modest at 0.37x.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Thesis invalidates if price slips below the 486.40 swing low; enforce immediate stop discipline.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Displays premier Stage 2 leadership, holding cleanly above upward-trending key moving averages. Double bottom base structure displays tightness near the 1048.30 neckline, backed by strong momentum (RSI 71) and positive MACD confirmation.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Spectacular CANSLIM earnings acceleration with Q2 PAT up over 112% and revenue rising 45.9%. Supported by high operating margins (~22%), low debt leverage (0.37x debt-to-equity), and rapid CDMO/API expansion.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Setup fails if price drops below 960.72; cut losses without hesitation.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Textbook Stage 2 consolidation hovering within 1.5% of the 427.53 20-session pivot. Price demonstrates classic Minervini volatility contraction above rising 21-EMA and 50-SMA, supported by positive MACD and firm relative strength.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Full CANSLIM qualification with two consecutive quarters of >30% EPS growth paired with +32.2% top-line expansion. Demonstrates steady 13% financing margins and solid institutional sponsorship across diversified lending and insurance businesses.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Thesis fails if price breaches 404.52 support; exit promptly to limit drawdown.

ABDL.technical: Maintains an active Stage 2 advance above rising key moving averages. The recent pullback found support directly at the rising 21-EMA before a constructive bullish reclaim candle materialized toward the 855.55 trigger.
ABDL.fundamental: Revenue expanded 15.9% YoY on premium brand volumes, but bottom-line growth slowed to 9.7% in Q2 FY27. High valuation multiples (P/E ~99x) require faster bottom-line re-acceleration to sustain top-tier CANSLIM leadership status.
ABDL.risk: Violation of the 798.73 base pivot low aborts the pattern; apply strict stop rules.

ABSLAMC.technical: Cleared prior 20-session highs on an emphatic 2.48x average volume surge. Momentum is strong with RSI at 72 and positive MACD, though the rapid breakout into overhead zones raises late-entry extension risk.
ABSLAMC.fundamental: Despite total AUM topping ₹11 lakh crore, Q2 net profit fell -8.3% YoY due to a 33% surge in employee costs and ESOP provisions. Topline growth of 3.9% fails CANSLIM growth criteria, capping ratings.
ABSLAMC.risk: Thesis fails on a failed breakout reversal below 1057.60; execute an immediate defensive exit.
